name: Ayushman Bharat — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
administering_body: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
eligibility_criteria: Deprived rural families based on SECC 2011 criteria
Identified occupational categories of urban workers' families
All senior citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of income (recent expansion)
Families listed on the official PM-JAY beneficiary portal
benefits: Cashless health cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across public and empaneled private hospitals.
how_to_apply: Visit the nearest Ayushman Bharat kiosk at any empaneled hospital or Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and Ration Card, or verify eligibility on mera.pmjay.gov.in.

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
administering_body: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
eligibility_criteria: All pregnant women delivering in public health institutions
All sick infants up to 1 year of age accessing government health facilities
benefits: Completely free and cashless normal deliveries and C-sections, free drugs, free diagnostics, free blood, free diet during hospital stay, and free transport from home to hospital and back.
how_to_apply: Directly accessible at any government hospital, CHC, or PHC upon admission for delivery or infant illness.

name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK)
eligibility_criteria: Children from birth up to 18 years of age
Enrolled in government and government-aided schools or Anganwadi centers
benefits: Child health screening and early intervention services covering the 4 Ds: Defects at birth, Diseases, Deficiencies, and Development delays including disability. Free surgical correction for congenital heart disease and cleft palate.
how_to_apply: Screening is conducted at Anganwadi centers and schools by Mobile Health Teams. Referrals are sent to District Early Intervention Centers (DEIC).

name: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme (PMNDP)
administering_body: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
eligibility_criteria: Patients diagnosed with End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) requiring ongoing hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis
BPL (Below Poverty Line) patients receive 100% free sessions
benefits: Free hemodialysis sessions for BPL card holders at district hospitals; heavily subsidized rates for non-BPL patients.
how_to_apply: Register at the Dialysis Center of any participating District Hospital with nephrologist referral and BPL certificate.
coverage_amount: Free for BPL / Subsidized for Non-BPL

name: National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP) & Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana
eligibility_criteria: All notified TB patients registered on the Ni-kshay portal
Undergoing treatment in either public or private healthcare sector
benefits: 100% free anti-TB drugs, free molecular diagnostics (CBNAAT/Truenat), plus ₹500/month direct benefit transfer (DBT) to the patient's bank account for nutritional support during treatment.
how_to_apply: Report to any government DOTS center or private provider. Once notified on Ni-kshay, provide bank account details for financial credit.

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
administering_body: Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI)
eligibility_criteria: Open to all citizens of India without any income, age, or documentation barrier
benefits: Access to quality generic medicines at 50% to 90% cheaper prices compared to branded equivalents, covering over 1,900 medicines and 300 surgical devices.
how_to_apply: Walk into any of the 10,000+ Jan Aushadhi Kendras across the country with a valid medical prescription.

name: Mission Indradhanush (Universal Immunization Programme)
administering_body: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
eligibility_criteria: Infants and children under 5 years who are unvaccinated or partially vaccinated
benefits: Free life-saving vaccination against 12 vaccine-preventable diseases (Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Polio, Measles, Rubella, severe childhood TB, Hepatitis B, Meningitis, Pneumonia, Rotavirus, Japanese Encephalitis).
how_to_apply: Visit any government primary health center, Anganwadi center, or community immunization camp.

name: Tele-MANAS (National Tele Mental Health Programme)
administering_body: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, NIMHANS nodal center
eligibility_criteria: Any individual in distress, experiencing mental health issues, anxiety, depression, insomnia, or suicidal thoughts
benefits: 24/7 free, confidential psychological support, crisis counseling, and referral to mental health specialists in 20+ regional languages via toll-free dial-in.
how_to_apply: Toll-free number: 14416 or 1800-891-4416 from any phone anywhere in the country.

name: Employees' State Insurance Scheme (ESIS)
administering_body: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), Ministry of Labour and Employment
eligibility_criteria: Employees earning up to ₹21,000 per month in formal establishments with 10 or more workers
benefits: Full medical care for self and dependents from day one of employment, sickness cash benefits, maternity benefit (26 weeks paid leave), and disablement pensions.
how_to_apply: Employer registers employee on the ESIC portal; Pehchan card issued for accessing ESIC dispensaries and hospitals.

name: National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly (NPHCE)
administering_body: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefits: Dedicated weekly geriatric clinics at PHCs, geriatric units at district hospitals with specialized physiotherapy, free assistive devices, and home-care support for bedridden seniors.
how_to_apply: Visit the designated Geriatric OPD at any participating government hospital or district wellness center.
coverage_amount: Free Dedicated Geriatric Care & Assistive Devices
